## Shared scenes

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her mistake with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before going to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to take the blame directly. She bravely confronts the angry Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and explains her perspective, winning over the old lady with her sincerity and imagination. [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all, and she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) become firm friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> Noticing how plain Anne's dresses are compared to her peers, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly seeks Mrs. Lynde's help after an awkward attempt to shop at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) himself. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) sews a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves, which [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) presents to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning to her immense joy. Later, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), and the children perform successfully in their evening [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). Later, the children perform in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where [Anne](../character/anne.md) excels in her recitations, despite her initial nerves. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) discuss Anne's performance by the kitchen fire and consider her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) on Anne's thirteenth birthday, discussing growing up, school assignments, and romantic story plots. [Anne](../character/anne.md) proposes starting a story club to cultivate their imaginations, which eventually expands to include other classmates like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the story club's progress, defending their work and sharing her aspirations to be like Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to finish her household chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission to go, the girls travel to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), Aunt Josephine's estate, where they enjoy several days of town festivities, concerts, and dining out. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects warmly on the trip and her joy at returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) for looking into her pantry, and the two negotiate the purchase of the willow-ware platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) treats [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) to tea and bread while sharing the news that she is getting married. After successfully securing the platter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) drive home along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), reflecting on their adventurous day.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl
